title: A card's More actions menu appears on hover or focus and offers Reassign
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Technician "ZZAUTOTEST C96945 Ana" is active at this location and is pinned in your Board View.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C96945 Card Menu" has one Approved work order, unit "C96945-U1", led by "ZZAUTOTEST C96945 Ana".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C96945 Card Menu", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover the card for unit "C96945-U1".
  2. Click the "More actions" (…) button that appears.
  3. Read the menu items.
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Move the mouse off the card.
  6. Click once in the "Search" box.
  7. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  8. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for unit "C96945-U1".
custom_expected:
Step 1: the "More actions" (…) button appears on the card.

Step 2: the card's menu opens.

Step 3: the menu includes "Reassign lead technician".

Step 4: the menu closes.

Step 5: the "More actions" button is hidden again.

Step 6: the cursor is in the "Search" box.

Step 7: a card shows the focus ring.

Step 8: the card for unit "C96945-U1" shows the focus ring and its "More actions" (…) button shows without hovering.

AUTOMATION: READY
